name: Broken Tears
objectiveText: Maintain your reputation with the Magram, and bring 3 Broken Tears to Warug in the Magram Village. Broken Tears  ( 3 )   Magram Clan Centaur  ( Friendly )

comments.body:
cosmos loc is 38,90. Cave is called Bolgan's hole. It is located in the very southern part of the zone, you have to cross a rickety wooden susspension bridge to get there, and ther are a few mobs on the way. Hope this helps. 

As of today, np collecting the crystals.
Coordinates ARE at 38,91

Simple quest. There are crystals just inside the mouth of the cave (at least three). Just right click on three crystals, and leave.

Cave is over the bridge in kolkar camp, you can jump down, or work your way around. Either way, you will have to clear a few 34/35 mobs but quest itself is pretty easy.

First time in, I walked right by crystals. Thought the drops would be in furthest reaches of the cave...lol

the entrance to the cave is 38,90. If you're in the gelkis camp look up and you'll see a bridge, well the bad part is walking around until you find the bridge. The good part is these guys give some good experience so take advantage of that. If you're having problems just wait a few more lvls, i easily did this with my 34 hunter

When you get to the Gelkis camp, you can either be cautious and kill your way to the cave or be reckless and walk along the edge, and jump down near the ramp [b](DISMISS minions/pets before you do)[/b]. Either way, you get there. 
    There's usually around [b]2-4 crystals right there[/b] at the mouth of the cave, and so this quest is fairly painless. However, if there's only two and you need one more, watch out for the Earthcaller/Minion PAT that paces that strech of cave. Another crystal shouls be close by.
    [b](PS: The centaur spawn faster than most thing's I've run into...get in and out as fast as possible.)[/b]
Did this quest with 33 hunter...32 any-class should breeze this..
I stopped killing as soon as I became friendly with the magram but still get mobbed by the elementals on sight, which in turn aggroes the rest.
Had to kill 1 mob guarding the entrance then took 3 pieces right at the entrance off the cave.  There is a lvl 35 patrol that comes to the entrance and walks back in.
it's hard to find the entrance to the cave, anyone have any suggestions?
replies: go to the camp and jump down (carefullu\y) into the large pit. You'll see a hill with a path up it- follow it- it goes across a bridge that goes up to the cave

comments.body: I did it as a lvl 34 hunter. Didn't have to fight a thing. Just made sure I stopped fighting the Gelkis the second I was friendly with the Magram. That way I wasn't Hated by the Gelkis, still nuetral. No problems with being attacked. If you make sure your reputation with the Gelkis doesn't go down too much, you should be able to do this quest quite easily.
Well the guy the hoard turn the quest into is located at 75.68 up on top of a hill.  He is hard to find if you dont have the coords and I did get the next quest from him.  Hope this helps!

Just make sure that [b]AS SOON AS YOU ARE FRIENDLY[/b] on part one of the quest line - [b]STOP KILLING THEM[/b].  They'll be orange for this quest, and won't attack you at all.  You can walk right in and break their crystals, and they won't even look at you :D
replies: Nope, when you hand in the quest to Warug you will also lose rep, landing you on Hostile.

comments.body: im a human rogue and i grinded friendly with the magram while staying unfriendly with the galkin.  as a human just stop once u hit friendly then they will NOT attack u as you do this quest cuz they apparently dont attack at unfriendly.

I found the easiest way to find this entrance is to go to the Gelkis Village and too the left youll see the gouge.. just look from the edge and youll see the middle hill has a path going up it. I suggest jump down from the edge.. its quicker.. hope this helps..
yah i agree with you, im level 32 and its pretty hard to kill all the mobs. i only got 1 crystal and i cant complete the rest
For some reason, I cant break the crystals or right click on them?  Anyone have any idea why?
The exp makes it worth it

2650xp @ 33/34 (I levelled while turning it in)

I got lucky and found the tears right in the entrance to the cave.  Watch out for some wandering types.
leads to Gizmo for Warug

They are found on the lower cave walls and 1-2 usually respawn when a centaur does, so if you can't find any crystals kill some centaurs and wait for respawn. This quest is really easy and I completed in around 15mins (including walk to Warug).

The "Broken tears" needed for this quest are dot droped from any creature. I killed a few rymblers that are supposed to drop it 60% of the time but I found none. You acctualy just do what the quest sais. Enter the cave and you will find them on the cave walls.
What is the XP reward?
why all so much strategy this isnt hard..just kill the few gelkis stampers and finish the quest EZ solo'd with a 31lock

Go into your reputation tab(U). scrll down to "gelkis centaurs" and click on the bar. then a little window pops up and you can DEselect "at war." when it's deselected, it makes the centaurs not attack you. i walked past them all and got the crystals.

cosmos loc is 38,90.   Cave is called Bolgan's hole.  It is located in the very southern part of the zone, you have to cross a rickety wooden susspension bridge to get there, and ther are a few mobs on the way.  Hope this helps.

We guessed that it was the big light blue crystals stuck to the walls of the cave, but if we put our cursor over it nothing changed with the icon.  We couldn't right click on them or anything.  After basically clearing the entire cave, we just gave up.
